_README: Template for real executor/reviewer runs. Copy it, fill it in OUTSIDE the repository,
and never commit the copy. Nothing here contains or should contain a secret.
Live dispatch stays OFF until every one of these is true:
1. runners[*].enabled = true AND a non-zero budget is set by the owner
2. the credentials below exist in the operator's trusted environment
3. the stop file path is writable by whoever must be able to stop this
4. a persistent trigger exists to call the controller (see docs/ACTIVATION.md)
controller.py refuses mode != replay in this build, on purpose.

command: You are the EXECUTOR. Read {prompt_file}. Work at {head}. Emit JSON: {"new_head": "<sha>", "cost": <usd>}.

You are the INDEPENDENT REVIEWER. You did not write this. Review {head} from a fresh clone. Emit JSON: {"review": {"head": "...", "reviewer": "...", "decision": "APPROVED|APPROVED_WITH_CONDITIONS|BLOCKED|NEEDS_INFORMATION", "evidence": ["..."]}, "cost": <usd>}.

credentials_expected_in_env: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or a Claude Code OAuth token — for the runners
GITHUB_TOKEN — push to the work branch only; must NOT be exposed to a PR checkout
run_budget_note: Unit is RUNS, not currency. One runner invocation costs 1. Subscription plans have no per-call price to meter; runs and wall-clock are what actually run out.
